claims.text: The woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground.
The scene should be a cinematic Hollywood sequence with dramatic expressions and camera movement.
A rain-soaked broken stone ridge above a dark battlefield, with cold blue-grey storm light and distant fires, is chosen as the setting.

description.text: A wide view across a rain-soaked ridge of broken stone above a darkening battleground.
crouches low on the crest, membranous wings half-spread and dragging in the wind, spikes bristling along its neck and back while rain beads and runs down the charcoal scales.

sits forward in the saddle at the base of its neck, both hands locked on the harness, shoulders braced into the gusts as she scans the field below. Cold blue-grey storm light, wet rock shining, distant fires glowing through the haze beyond the ridge.
The dragon settles its weight onto the crest and half-spreads its wings while the rider leans forward and tightens her grip on the harness.
Rain sweeps the exposed ridge and wind gusts hard over the stone.
A fresh gust drives sheets of rain across the ridge, and the rider's gaze drops toward the battlefield below.
A medium close view of

as the storm lashes her face. Rain streaks across the shaved sides of her hair and darkens the high collar of her technical jacket; her jaw sets and her eyes narrow into the wind, tracking something in the field below. The camera arcs slowly around her, holding her profile against the rain-veiled ridge and the blurred sweep of the dragon's wing behind her.
Her jaw sets and her eyes narrow into the wind as she follows the battlefield below.
Gusting wind presses against fabric and the leather harness creaks faintly.
A wide view as
drives off the crest and drops into a steep dive, wings sweeping wide and horns cutting the air,

braced low along its neck with her body flattened to the scales. The battleground rushes up beneath them: churned mud, broken ground and ragged lines scattering outward as the dark shape passes overhead and the tracking camera keeps pace with the fall.
The dragon launches off the ridge and plunges into a steep dive while the rider flattens herself against its neck.
Heavy wingbeats hammer the air and wind rushes past the rider.
A medium view as
slams down onto the battlefield, wings flaring wide to catch the impact, mud and water bursting outward and its head snapping toward the enemy line.
rises in the saddle, chin lifting, one arm braced on the harness as the shockwave rocks the frame and spray hangs in the storm light.
The dragon strikes the ground and flares its wings; the rider rises in the saddle and lifts her chin.
A wet, ground-shaking impact throws mud and debris outward.

soundscape: Rain hisses across broken stone, wind gusts over the ridge, a leather harness creaks, heavy wingbeats hammer the air, and the landing drives a wet, ground-shaking impact with scattering mud and debris.
music: A low orchestral swell with deep brass and a rising string tremolo builds across the five seconds, cresting as the dragon lands.
